decision: Proceed with SylvanSport partnership for fabric sourcing?
context: Steve Conley (SylvanSport Finance & Supply) offered to share fabric suppliers + volume discounts. SylvanSport is NC-based, established outdoor gear company (founded 2004, IDEA Gold award winner). Nomadixgear currently sourcing from China, seeking non-Chinese alternatives for glamping tents (Octagome, Hexagome). Sample tent received for fabric analysis.
constraints: Timeline: Pilot supplier within 1-2 weeks. Budget: Unknown, expecting 20%+ cost reduction. MOQ: Must accept smaller order volumes initially (growing rapidly). Quality: Must meet luxury glamping standards (3000mm+ waterproof, UPF 50+).
success_criteria: 20%+ cost reduction vs Chinese suppliers, 2+ non-Chinese suppliers secured, quality testing passed, MOQ terms acceptable, lead time <6 weeks
